newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania gets 10 bids for $200 mln bond launch.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania gets 10 bids for $200 mln bond launch.

text.p: Lithuania has received expressions of interest to carry out a new $200 million eurobond issue from a total of 10 international banks, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.
Lithuanian announced the intention to launch a new bond in January and says the funds will be used for general budgetary purposes.
"We have bids from 10 banks," the finance ministry official told Reuters but would not name any of the banks nor the coupon that they had proposed.
The new issue would be by far the largest for Lithuania since it entered the international capital markets in late 1995.
So far it has launched a two-year $60 million eurobond in December 1995, which it then upped by $50 million. The issue was arranged by Nomura.

A date has not been set for new issue, which Lithuania has said will depend on market conditions. After a new credit rating by IBCA in late January, it hopes to improve on the 10 percent coupon paid on the first bond issue.
